description: A sample-and-hold split in two, in 2HP: one control captures the input into memory and another sends that memory to the output, with a reset that clears it

params.text: Captures the input into memory, for one cycle per press in Single mode or for as long as it is held in Continuous mode
Switches the control beside it between Single, where the button is momentary and the jack reads a trigger, and Continuous, where the button latches and the jack reads a gate
Sends what is in memory to the output, once per press in Single mode or continuously while held in Continuous mode
Clears the memory to 0V, and updates the output too unless the menu says to clear memory only
Chooses what is stored and put out: Val. passes the voltage itself, Gt. turns it into a gate high or low, Trg. counts triggers seen while sampling

inputs.text: Captures the input into memory, read as a trigger or as a gate according to the small button beside it
Sends what is in memory to the output, read as a trigger or as a gate according to the small button beside it
Clears the memory, read as a trigger or as a gate according to the small button beside it
The signal to be captured; unpatched it reads 0V

outputs.text: Carries whatever was last sent out of memory, holding it until the next update

notes: nothing reaches the output until an update happens, so a plain sample-and-hold means leaving the Update button latched in Continuous mode and triggering Sample
the three small mode buttons are red for Single and green for Continuous; in Single mode the big button above is momentary and in Continuous mode it latches
in Trg. mode the output fires one trigger once the counted number of input triggers has been reached at the moment of an update, so it works as a clock divider
menu: Reset-mode: Only reset, Reset and update — chooses whether a reset also pushes the cleared memory to the output
Reset trigger count: Only on Reset, Only on Update (count reached), Reset and Update (count reached) — chooses what clears the counter in Trg. mode
Trigger count: 1 to 16 — sets how many input triggers must have been counted before an update fires the output trigger
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it
Trigger-high output-level — sets the voltage a trigger pulse carries during its 1ms high phase, 10V unless you change it
Trigger-low output-level — sets the voltage a trigger output carries between pulses, 0V unless you change it
